query:
SELECT violationType, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM supervisor_audit 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND violationType IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY violationType ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15;
